_meta.about: Per-building architecture spec for Grand Kifisia (research-arch). Every key not starting with "_" is a building: the OSM id exactly as kifisia_map.json stores it in buildings[i][11].id ("w<way>" / "r<relation>"); field "map" = index into MAP.buildings at generation time (re-match by id, or by x,z if the map is rebuilt). confidence: photo = checked against an open-licence photo listed in photos/source; osm = levels/roof from OSM tags; inferred = style class chosen from street character / footprint / map data, NOT verified. Units metres. Style classes and their proportions: "_styles" below and docs/research/ARCHITECTURE_KIFISIA.md.

neo_villa.label: Kifisia neoclassical / eclectic villa or town house, 1880-1930 (summer-resort era after the 1885 railway)
neo_villa.plinth: rusticated stone or grey-rendered plinth 0.6-1.6 m with 3-10 marble entrance steps

windows.frame: white moulded surround 0.15 m, small cornice or triangular/segmental pediment above upper windows
windows.shutters: timber louvred, dark green #3d5e46 or grey-blue #6c7f8a, or painted blue frames

neo_villa.symmetry: 3 or 5 bays, symmetric, central entrance; central balcony over the entrance

balcony.slab: white marble 0.12 m on carved consoles

neo_villa.cornice: projecting moulded cornice 0.5-0.8 m deep under the eaves; corner pilasters or quoins
neo_villa.roof: hip 25-30 deg, Byzantine/Marseille clay tiles #a9553a-#b8664a, eaves 0.6-0.9 m with dark timber soffit and brackets; sometimes a small central cross-gable or pediment (salmon or white tympanum); chimneys

chalet_villa.label: Romantic 'Swiss chalet' villa, 1890-1925 (rough honey limestone, steep gables with carved white bargeboards)
chalet_villa.walls: rough-faced honey limestone ashlar #c4a68a with darker joints #8a7461; rusticated quoins/window surrounds in larger paler blocks #cbb093; white string course at first floor

windows.frame: white timber casements, 6-8 small panes, segmental arches

chalet_villa.roof: steep gable 45-55 deg, red-orange tiles #a8553a, deep white timber bargeboards with carved brackets, king-post truss and turned finial at the apex, dormers with their own small gables

balcony.type: white timber balcony on carved brackets at the gable window; white stone balustrade over a canted bay

eclectic_pavilion.label: White eclectic pavilion with round corner towers (Agora / Kolokotroni 7 group)
eclectic_pavilion.towers: round, 5-6 m diameter, conical grey roofs with gold finials, scalloped terracotta-tile cornice
eclectic_pavilion.windows: tall arched display windows, white mouldings, fleur-de-lis frieze

interwar.label: Interwar / early post-war masonry building 1925-1960: 2-3 storeys, rendered or stone, flat roof or low hip, simple cornices, often converted to shops

windows.frame: plain render band or stone surround

balcony.rail: simple iron bars or solid parapet; corner balconies with rounded slab

interwar.roof: flat with parapet and thin cornice, or low hip with tiles

poly_6080.label: Athenian polykatoikia 1960-1985 (antiparochi era): the commonest block in the centre
poly_6080.groundFloor: shops with full glazing between square columns, marble/granite cladding on the columns, roll-shutter boxes; or pilotis (open parking) on residential streets

balcony.type: continuous cantilevered slab along the street front
balcony.rail: anodised aluminium bars #b9bcbf (commonest), black iron, or solid masonry parapet 0.9 m with marble cap

poly_6080.awnings: one fabric drop awning per balcony bay: beige #d8c9a3, green #4f6b4a, terracotta #b55b3c, blue-white or green-white stripes; arms at ~2.2 m above slab
poly_6080.windows: balcony doors 2.2 m high full-height aluminium sliders + external roll shutters (box 0.25 m) in white/beige/brown; bedroom windows 1.2 x 1.4 m
poly_6080.roof: flat concrete roof with 0.9 m parapet, stair bulkhead, solar water heaters (flat panels + horizontal tank), TV antennas, AC units; frequently a set-back top floor (retiré) with its own terrace
examples: white block along Kassaveti in ref/r11.jpg
blocks along Kifisias Ave in ref/r09.jpg

poly_8000.label: Polykatoikia 1985-2005 typical of Kifisia's garden-suburb code: 2-4 storeys, pitched tiled roof or tiled pergola on the retiré, stone-clad base, individual/recessed balconies

balcony.type: individual or recessed loggias, some bay windows
balcony.rail: solid masonry parapet with iron top rail, or iron balusters

poly_8000.walls: render in ochre/cream/apricot, stone cladding (grey-beige limestone) on the ground floor and on vertical strips
poly_8000.roof: low hip with red tiles over the top floor, or flat with tiled-roof pergola; parapet

poly_modern.label: Contemporary block 2005-2025: white/grey render or large-format stone/HPL cladding, frameless glass balustrades, deep recessed balconies, flat roof with hidden plant

balcony.rail: frameless glass 1.0 m with steel cap

retail_modern.label: Modern retail / office building: curtain-wall glazing or stone panels, flush signage, 2-3 storeys, flat roof

arcade_retail.label: Low commercial arcade block around Platanos: 1-2 storeys behind a deep colonnade of square cream pillars, low hipped terracotta roof with wide eaves, café terraces under the arcade
arcade_retail.pillar: 0.5 x 0.5 m cream render, spacing 4-5 m
examples: Kifisias 236 and the KFC block (ref/r09.jpg drone view)

villa_modern.label: Detached house / maisonette 1975-2015 in a garden: 2-3 storeys, tiled hip roof, stone-clad base, arched openings or pergolas, behind a garden wall and railings
villa_modern.roof: hip 25-30 deg, red tiles, eaves 0.5 m

house_suburban.label: Small older house (1 storey or 2), tiled hip roof, shutters

hotel.label: Hotel: 3-5 storeys, individual iron balconies, entrance canopy

church.label: Orthodox church: cross-in-square, central dome on drum, bell tower(s), cream render, red tiles

station.label: Kifisia Line 1 station: long single storey, ochre-yellow #e8c766 with white pilasters, central pediment with clock

school.label: School building (ISA campus etc.): 2-3 storeys, flat roof, ribbon windows, rendered; see docs/research/PLACES.md for ISA

ancillary.label: Garage, shed, plant room: 1 storey, plain render, flat roof

w1075949217.name: HSBC corner (Kassaveti 1 / Platanos square)
w1075949217.notes: Seen from Platanos square (photo taken at x -70 z 37) looking east: long 2-storey neoclassical front on Kifisias Ave, cream plaster (overcast raw sample #8b7f74 -> daylight ~#e6dcc4), the end wing at the Kassaveti corner carries a low salmon-pink pediment. Ground floor: shop bays (HSBC sign in red/black letters on the cream fascia - the HSBC branch may have closed; Vivify, Travel Plan, Pansik in the plainer 3-storey modern block at the left/north end with continuous balconies). Grey stone kerb fountain/monument and red-brick pavement at the corner. Building identification = photo position + HSBC/Vivify tenants of map b291 (Kassaveti 1).
